mapper.select: SELECT BOOKSET_ID code,BOOKSET_NAME name,BOOKSET_NAME shortName,BOOKSET_ID hidCode FROM BOK_BOOKSET a where 1=1 order by bookset_type,BOOKSET_ID

SELECT BOOKSET_ID code,BOOKSET_NAME name,BOOKSET_NAME shortName,BOOKSET_ID hidCode FROM BOK_BOOKSET a where 1=1
and bookset_type='01' order by bookset_type,BOOKSET_ID

SELECT BOOKSET_ID code,BOOKSET_NAME name,BOOKSET_NAME shortName,BOOKSET_ID hidCode FROM BOK_BOOKSET where 1=1
AND BOOKSET_TYPE = #{booksetType}
AND (BOOKSET_ID like concat_ws('%',concat_ws(#{param},'%')) OR BOOKSET_NAME like concat_ws('%',concat_ws(#{param},'%')))
order by bookset_type,BOOKSET_ID

SELECT A.BOOKSET_ID AS booksetId, A.BOOKSET_NAME AS booksetName, A.BOOKSET_TYPE AS booksetType, A.ACCT_SUBJECT_ID AS acctSubjectId, A.STANDARD_CCY AS standardCcy, A.ACCT_SUBJECT_TYPE AS acctSubjectType, A.BOOKSET_ID_TMPL AS booksetIdTmpl, B.ACCT_STANDARD_NAME AS acctStandard, A.START_DATE AS startDate, A.END_DATE AS endDate FROM BOK_BOOKSET A LEFT JOIN bok_ACCT_STANDARD B ON B.ACCT_STANDARD_ID=A.ACCT_STANDARD WHERE BOOKSET_TYPE=#{booksetType}
AND BOOKSET_Id=(select F_PROD_ID from rep_prod_info where PROD_ID = #{booksetName,jdbcType=VARCHAR})
SELECT DISTINCT BOOKSET_ID,BOOKSET_NAME FROM BOK_BOOKSET order by BOOKSET_ID
select sysi.institution_name from chb_org_regist_bank_code corbc inner join sys_institution sysi on corbc.org_code=sysi.institution_code and corbc.status='E' where rownum=1

select sysi.institution_name from data_auth_notify_inst dani inner join sys_institution sysi on dani.institution_code=sysi.institution_code where dani.business_id=#{booksetOrg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dani.data_type='V08' and dani.model_type='02' and rownum=1

select distinct sysi.institution_name from sys_batch_prd_grp sbpg inner join sys_batch_grp_prdlink sbgpl on sbpg.seq_no=sbgpl.group_seq inner join data_auth_notify_inst dani on sbgpl.product_id=dani.business_id inner join sys_institution sysi on dani.institution_code=sysi.institution_code where seq_no=#{booksetOrg,jdbcType=VARCHAR} and dani.data_type='V08' and dani.model_type='02' and rownum=1
